approved_by: architect (Codex), after the development-anchored cap was frozen
status_label: RESEARCH ONLY (amendment F1): decision protection does not authorise promotion
changes: The development-relative excess-stock cap (5/4 x the selected method's worst development ratio) is a RESEARCH STABILITY CHECK: it tests whether final behaviour stays within development behaviour. It is not an acceptable-cost criterion.

All decision-protection results (A2 and A0) are research-only. Their checks are computed and reported exactly as in protocol v1, but no result, pass or fail, authorises a safety-stock suggestion, a promotion or any production change.

Promotion of decision protection requires, in a future protocol with its own reservation: (i) a sequential inventory evaluation (multi-cycle replay with the Stage 2 engine: carried stock, open orders, lead times, review cycles), and (ii) an acceptable-cost criterion fixed in advance (for example shortage versus holding cost, or a seller-set trade-off).
unchanged: all other gates of protocol v1
